data.name: STM_001
data.value: This heat is suffocating...[pause=15] We must be nearing a magma pocket.

data.name: STM_002
data.value: Hear that, [player]?[pause=15] Sounds like... pressurized steam.

data.name: STM_003
data.value: Steam![pause=10] It's coming from everywhere!

data.name: STM_004
data.value: A Torkoal![pause=10] It's blocking our path!

data.name: STM_005
data.value: A Magmar too![pause=10] They've surrounded us!

data.name: STM_006
data.value: The Forge-Masters of the depths...

data.name: STM_007
data.value: That voice again!

data.name: STM_008
data.value: They have guarded the furnaces for centuries.[pause=20] Their heat will consume you.

data.name: STM_009
data.value: Unless you prove your own flame...

data.name: STM_010
data.value: We didn't come all this way for nothing![pause=10] [player], let's go!

data.name: STM_011
data.value: We're back.[pause=15] This time, we're ready!

data.name: STM_012
data.value: We survived the furnace!

data.name: STM_013
data.value: That voice...[pause=15] It seems to know everything about this dungeon.

data.name: STM_014
data.value: It's like it's testing us.[pause=20] Let's continue.

data.name: STM_015
data.value: The flames consumed you...

data.name: STM_016
data.value: But fire tempers steel.[pause=30] Return, stronger.

data.name: STM_017
data.value: I...[pause=5] I can't go on...[pause=15] We have to fall back!

data.name: STM_018
data.value: Torkoal blows a plume of black smoke.[pause=15] Magmar sneers.[pause=10] The heat is unbearable.

data.name: STM_019
data.value: The flames are just beginning.[pause=20] Come back when you can withstand them.

data.name: STM_020
data.value: They retreat into the furnace.[pause=20] The embers crackle in the darkness.

data.name: STM_021
data.value: Magmar collapses, its flames flickering.[pause=10] Torkoal steps back,[pause=5] its shell smoking.

data.name: STM_022
data.value: Torkoal stares at you with its red eyes.[pause=20] A long silence.

data.name: STM_023
data.value: Your flame...[pause=20] is stronger than ours.[pause=25] Pass.

data.name: STM_024
data.value: They sink into the molten tunnel,[pause=15] their embers slowly dying out.

data.name: STM_025
data.value: We survived the furnace![pause=10] Literally!

data.name: STM_026
data.value: Even fire bows before your determination.[pause=25] Continue.

data.name: STM_027
data.value: Fire tests those the grass let through.

data.name: STM_028
data.value: The lava clan is letting us through... the camp can't be far now.

data.name: STM_029
data.value: The rock is hot through my paws. We shouldn't linger.

data.name: STM_030
data.value: Those two aren't guarding a passage. They're guarding a home.

data.name: STM_031
data.value: Then we're the intruders here.

data.name: STM_032
data.value: Every traveller is, until proven otherwise.

data.name: STM_033
data.value: The heat is rising. Breathing hurts.

data.name: STM_034
data.value: Short breaths. Don't fill your lungs. Follow me.

data.name: STM_035
data.value: They part without a word. The way ahead is open.

data.name: STM_036
data.value: No cheering this time. It doesn't feel like a victory.

data.name: STM_037
data.value: It isn't one. It's an agreement.

data.name: STM_040
data.value: The heat shifts. Something is moving in the slag.

data.name: STM_041
data.value: Five glowing shapes rise from the floor and close a slow circle around the team.

data.name: STM_042
data.value: They've cut us off. Front, sides... they knew exactly where we'd come out.

data.name: STM_043
data.value: Nobody moves. Nobody draws. Let them speak first.

data.name: STM_044
data.value: Turn around, little ones. This is as far as the tunnel forgives.

data.name: STM_045
data.value: Below this floor the furnace has gone wrong. The flow no longer keeps its hours.

data.name: STM_046
data.value: We are not guarding a door. We are keeping the last safe ring around it.

data.name: STM_047
data.value: Our own brood already burned down there. We will not add yours to them.

data.name: STM_048
data.value: They're not blocking us out of spite...[pause=15] they're trying to keep us alive.

data.name: STM_049
data.value: The herd in the steppe tested us. These two are warning us. It isn't the same thing.

data.name: STM_050
data.value: Then we tell them the truth. We can't turn back either.

data.name: STM_051
data.value: An expedition is missing down there. If the flow is breaking, they have less time than we do.

data.name: STM_052
data.value: ...You would walk into the furnace for strangers.

data.name: STM_053
data.value: Then prove your fire is worth the walk. Ours has kept this ring for two hundred years.

data.name: STM_054
data.value: Stand. If you fall to us, the furnace would have eaten you anyway.

data.name: STM_055
data.value: The circle opens. The Slugma sink back into the slag without a sound.

data.name: STM_056
data.value: Enough. Your fire holds.

data.name: STM_057
data.value: Listen well, then. The flow surges when the deep chamber breathes out. Count the tremors.

data.name: STM_058
data.value: Three tremors, then the lava climbs. Cross on the fourth, never on the third.

data.name: STM_059
data.value: And down there... something speaks in the heat. It spoke before we were posted here.

data.name: STM_060
data.value: So the voice was here first. Before the tunnel went wrong.

data.name: STM_061
data.value: Go. And if you find our brood's mark down there, leave it standing.

data.name: STM_062
data.value: Count the tremors...[pause=15] I'm not going to forget that.
